item.title: A visit to the beach
item.description: Describe what you see at the beach and what you take with you. Learn words for activities on the sand and in the water.

children.definition: An area of sand or small stones beside the sea or a lake.
children.example: We found a clean beach near the village.

children.definition: A moving line of water that rises and then falls.
children.example: A wave came up the sand and wet our feet.

children.definition: Very small pieces of rock that cover many beaches.
children.example: We left our shoes on the dry sand.

children.definition: The hard cover of a small sea animal, which you can sometimes find empty on a beach.
children.example: I saw an empty white shell beside the rocks.

children.definition: A person whose job is to watch people in the water and help anyone in danger.
children.example: The lifeguard watched the swimmers from a high seat.
children.translation_ru: спасатель на пляже или у бассейна

children.definition: A place where direct sunlight is blocked.
children.example: We had lunch in the shade behind the beach café.

children.definition: Red or sore skin that you get after too much sun.
children.example: My shoulders were sore from sunburn after the trip.

children.definition: The regular rise and fall of the level of the sea.
children.example: When the tide went out, we could see more rocks.

children.definition: An open container with a handle, often used to carry water or sand.
children.example: The children filled a yellow bucket with wet sand.

children.definition: A shape made from sand that looks like a little building with towers.
children.example: Our sandcastle had three towers and a wall.

children.definition: A long tool with a flat end that you move through water to move a small boat.
children.example: Please put the paddle back beside the canoe.

children.definition: A large piece of cloth you use to dry yourself or sit on at the beach.
children.example: I spread my beach towel on the dry sand.

children.definition: A bird often seen by the sea, usually white and grey with long wings.
children.example: A seagull flew low over the boats.

children.definition: Long, flat things you wear on your feet to help you swim.
children.example: The swimmer took off her flippers at the water’s edge.
